correctness.rationale: For P=K F(s)+y(A(s)+xB(s)), Q=-x(A(s)+xB(s)), s=x²+y², radial identity ds/dt=2KxF(s) yields invariant circles. The interpolated angular speeds a_i+r_i b_i cos θ are positive, have exact period 2π/√(a_i²-r_i²b_i²)=T_i; integrating the normal variational equation 2K r_iFʹ(r_i²)cos θ over original time gives log mu_i by the z_i parametrization. Nonunit mu_i makes each prescribed circle isolated. Every polynomial field with m such circular limit cycles has nonzero xP+yQ divisible by F(s); since xP+yQ vanishes at origin and F(0)≠0 the residual factor is nonconstant, forcing d>=2m. Constructed field visibly degree exactly 2m.
residual_risks: Extra periodic orbits/equilibria not excluded; independence excludes mu_i=1. Direct quadratures tested selected examples, not all radii.
